description: Central Province - Declaring the orders pertaining to the Business of Pawn Broking under Pawn Brokers statute No. 04 of 2014 of the Central Province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the implementation of a provincial statute (Pawn Brokers Statute No. 04 of 2014) and establishes specific regulatory orders for pawn broking businesses, including registration fees, license fees, security deposits, and identification requirements. While it mentions a government official (Sarath Ekanayake) in his ministerial capacity, the core content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio descriptions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
